about: Read notes.md and tell me the release day. Don't run commands. / /compact / Without reading anything, which day did notes.md name? A turn, a manual compaction, then a turn that leans on the summary.

known.reason: Grok 1.0.46 reports a /compact with auto_compact_completed, the notice of its own compactions. Mako's ACP host labels the one it asked for Manual (asManualCompaction in packages/host/src/harnesses/acp.ts), which the decoder alone does not know; the store reads it from the /compact turn Grok saves after it.
